Achieve noticeably brighter, smoother, and more radiant skin with the Chemical Peel with Dermaplane treatment at AestheticEye. This advanced skin rejuvenation service combines the power of manual exfoliation through dermaplaning with the transformative effects of a customized chemical peel. Performed by our licensed medical aesthetician and overseen by board-certified oculoplastic surgeon Dr. Jonathan Pargament, this combination therapy is ideal for those looking to enhance skin clarity, tone, and texture without the downtime of more invasive procedures.

Double the Exfoliation, Double the Results

Dermaplaning involves gently scraping away dead skin cells and fine vellus hair (peach fuzz) using a sterile surgical blade. This process creates a clean, even surface and allows the chemical peel to penetrate more deeply and evenly. When paired with a carefully selected peel – ranging from mild to medium depth- this dual treatment reveals younger-looking skin and accelerates cellular turnover.

According to the American Academy of Dermatology, chemical peels are one of the most effective non-invasive treatments for improving skin tone and reducing signs of aging. By combining it with dermaplaning, the results can be more immediate and long-lasting.

What Skin Concerns Does This Treatment Address?

This synergistic treatment is especially beneficial for a range of skin conditions, including:

  • Dull, uneven skin tone
  • Fine lines and wrinkles
  • Acne and mild acne scars
  • Hyperpigmentation and sun damage
  • Dry or flaky skin
  • Rough texture

The dermaplane-chemical peel combo is safe for most skin types and is frequently used on the face, neck, and décolletage.

Frequently Asked Questions About Chemical Peel with Dermaplane

Is it safe for all skin types?

Most skin types tolerate this treatment well, but our aesthetician will ensure it’s right for you.

How often can I get this treatment?

Depending on your skin needs, every 4–6 weeks is ideal.

Will I peel after the treatment?

Some flaking may occur, especially with medium-depth peels, but this varies by skin type.

Can I wear makeup afterward?

Yes, makeup can typically be worn the next day, but we recommend letting your skin breathe for optimal healing.
